description: This file defines an authentication context for a React application, including state management for tokens and user profile, and provides functions for login, signup, logout, and token refresh. It uses React hooks and context API to manage authentication state and exposes a custom hook for consuming the auth context.

methods.name: getStoredTokens
methods.description: Retrieves stored tokens from local storage, parsing JSON if available.

methods.name: setStoredTokens
methods.description: Stores tokens in local storage or removes them if null.
